Generics

Nabu supports full generic types, with JVM generic signatures emitted both ways. ## Parameterized classes ```java public class Box { private final value: T; public Box(value: T) { this.value = value; } public fun getValue(): T { return value; } } ``` ## Supported generic features - **Parameterized types** — full signature support in both directions (via the ASM `SignatureParser` visitors) - **Bounded type parameters** — `` via `typeBound` / `additionalBound` - **Wildcards** — `? extends T` and `? super T` (`CWildcardType`) - **Generic method invocation inference** — implemented through `UndetVarType` and `TypeMapFiller`/`TypeMapApplier` - **`var`** — local type inference is supported
